options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Victory Goals
options.doc:
Which spirits, need to defeat which adversaries, at what level, to have completed the game.

Defeating an adversary at a level higher than the target level also counts as defeating them on a lower level.
Selecting multiple levels for the same spirit + adversary will have the lower values ignored.
Selecting many goals may introduce a lot of useless filler items.

options.name: Advanced Victory Goals
options.doc:
Which spirits, need to defeat which adversaries, at what level, to have completed the game.

This setting replaces the settings in "Victory Goals" if present.
This setting allows you to specify the boss as an yaml in the form.
It allows you to weight spirit selection chances.
See the Game Page for examples.
options.doc_html:
Which spirits, need to defeat which adversaries, at what level, to have completed the game.

This setting replaces the settings in "Victory Goals" if present. This setting allows you to specify the boss as an yaml in the form. It allows you to weight spirit selection chances. See the Game Page for examples.

options.name: Island shards offset
options.doc:
How many island shards (victory goals) you may skip whilst still completing the game.

I.e. if this value is 1 and you have 4 goals the game will complete once you achieved 3 goals.
If this value is greater than or equal to the number of goals it will be set to goals - 1.
options.doc_html:
How many island shards (victory goals) you may skip whilst still completing the game.

I.e. if this value is 1 and you have 4 goals the game will complete once you achieved 3 goals. If this value is greater than or equal to the number of goals it will be set to goals - 1.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de shards d'île (objectifs de victoire) vous pouvez sauter tout en complétant le jeu.

I.e. si cette valeur est 1 et que vous avez 4 buts, le jeu sera terminé une fois que vous avez atteint 3 buts.
Si cette valeur est supérieure ou égale au nombre d'objectifs, elle sera fixée à des buts - 1.
options.doc_html_fr:

options.name: DeathLink
options.doc:
DeathLink is an opt-in feature for Multiworlds where individual death events are propagated to all games with DeathLink enabled.

- Disabled: Nothing will happen when you die or when other players trigger a death event.

- Lost game: A DeathLink broadcast will be sent every time you lose or abbandon a game.
options.doc_html:
DeathLink is an opt-in feature for Multiworlds where individual death events are propagated to all games with DeathLink enabled.

  • Disabled: Nothing will happen when you die or when other players trigger a death event.
  • Lost game: A DeathLink broadcast will be sent every time you lose or abbandon a game.
options.doc_fr:
DeathLink est une fonctionnalité d'opt-in pour Multiworlds où les événements de mort individuels sont propagés à tous les jeux avec DeathLink activé.

- Disabled: Rien ne se passera quand vous mourrez ou quand d'autres joueurs déclencheront un événement mortel.

- Lost game: Une émission DeathLink sera envoyée chaque fois que vous perdez ou abbandonnez un jeu.
options.doc_html_fr:

options.name: Elements Fill Ratio
options.doc:
What percentage of filler items (after filling with extra spirits) should be +element.

0 means no filler items are +element.
100 means all filler items are +element.

Bonus elements last only a single turn.
Fill items that are not +element, are friendly greetings that do not have an effect on the game.
